title: Full production gradient-flow well-posedness and pinned equilibrium selection
statement: Conditional on A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL, for the canonical P1 variational functional on a fixed three-torus at the pinned production parameters and eta_shell=0, the full linear operator on the real Hilbert space L2(T3;C3) is self-adjoint on H4 and coercive in H2, the lower-order Euler-Lagrange map is locally Lipschitz H2 to L2, and the canonical gradient flow has a unique global H2 solution with continuous dependence, the exact energy identity, and positive-time C-infinity smoothing. R-157 additionally proves the exact bounds F_P1[Psi] >= g||Psi||_2^2 with g=719818750025582338837/5400000000000000000000>1/8 and <DF_P1(Psi),Psi> >= kappa||Psi||_2^2 with kappa=2101675000076747016511/8100000000000000000000>1/4. Hence Psi=0 is the unique critical point and global minimizer in the unconstrained H2 field space, and ||Psi(t)||_2^2 <= exp(-2 kappa t)||Psi(0)||_2^2 for the canonical L2 gradient flow.
scope: T6 CONDITIONAL-THEOREM: Psi in the unconstrained linear space H2(T3;C3) on the fixed periodic cell, treated as six real components with the real L2 pairing; the hash-pinned A1 P1 reference functional and production coefficients including positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers; eta_shell exactly zero; conditional on A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL. R-157 covers equilibrium selection and exponential L2 decay only for this declared functional and its canonical gradient flow. The historical external backend, signed A7 stochastic composite, nonzero shell-bias continuum limits, data below H2, infinite volume, fixed norm or charge, compact CP2 targets, chemical-potential transforms, conserved or alternative dynamics, other parameter/function families, and physical-vacuum selection are excluded.
falsifier: A non-Hermitian production linear term; failure of the H2 lower bound, Class-II positivity, local-Lipschitz map, Galerkin passage, energy identity, continuation, smoothing, or uniqueness; an exact pinned field with F_P1[Psi]<g||Psi||_2^2; a nonzero critical point contradicting <DF_P1(Psi),Psi> >= kappa||Psi||_2^2; or a canonical gradient-flow solution violating the stated exponential L2 estimate in the declared unconstrained scope.
no_overclaim: R-157 applies only to the unconstrained hash-pinned P1/A2 classical functional on the fixed torus with eta_shell=0 and to its canonical L2 gradient flow. It makes Psi=0 the unique critical point and global minimizer and forces exponential L2 decay in that flow. It is not a physical-vacuum theorem; it does not apply to the historical backend, signed A7 stochastic composite, fixed-norm/charge or compact-target constraints, chemical-potential or conserved dynamics, other parameters/functionals, or general nonequilibrium transients.
